title: Size of a subcircuit construction
statement: For any two arithmetic circuits $C$ and $C'$ on the same number of inputs, the circuit formed by placing their gate lists together, shifting the node references of the second list by the size of the first, and appending a subtraction gate has size $\mathrm{size}(C)+\mathrm{size}(C')+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Circuits $C$ and $C'$ on the same number of inputs
